amendment_assessment.if_state_is_terminal_or_requires_row_ret: Do not invoke a fourth controller under version 5. A new prospective scientific amendment would be required for any new scientific attempt, and this review neither recommends nor authorizes one.
amendment_assessment.reason: The frozen protocol already distinguishes the later-cohort barrier and prohibition on scientific retries from supervision of the unchanged fixed-N payload. The ambiguity is in external shorthand, not the protocol rule.
amendment_assessment.required_before_optional_fourth: Publish or otherwise bind an additive external clarification with this narrow meaning; preserve the original admission and review unchanged. Reconcile live durable state against every fourth-controller precondition at decision time.

prior_operational_review.status: preserved unchanged; its fourth-controller phrase no scientific failure is clarified by this additive record

contract_reading.controller_role: A controller successor that claims the same durable request and supervises the same scientific process is infrastructure supervision, not a scientific retry. It may observe, checkpoint, preserve and publish results from the unchanged process within the existing G, D, worker-second, per-row attempt and restore caps.
contract_reading.fixed_n: The fixed-N rule defines 18 distinct planned executions and requires preservation of their outcomes. A timeout for seq 2 is one retained outcome; the other already-planned sequence numbers are not retries of seq 2.
contract_reading.later_cohort_barrier: The invalidation rule says a scientific cap or exhaustion blocks the later cohort. The observed watchdog timeout therefore remains visible and blocks later-cohort admission under version 5; completing collection of the current gate does not remove that barrier.
contract_reading.retry_prohibition: The prohibition on scientific retry after cap or exhaustion forbids another attempt at seq 2, replacement of its seed/method/cap, or restart of a terminal scientific gate as a new payload/run. It does not prohibit the unchanged, already-running scheduler from attempting the other distinct rows that were fixed before data.
contract_reading.terminal_boundary: Version 5 admits an optional fourth controller only while the exact request remains nonterminal before G. If the scientific request or process becomes terminally failed, version 5 does not admit a fourth controller to restart it. A separately evidenced infrastructure restore remains limited to the already-frozen maximum of one and cannot be used to re-run a row that reached its scientific watchdog cap.

allowed: continued controller supervision of the unchanged running fixed-N payload
collection of outcomes for the remaining distinct preregistered rows
preservation and publication of the seq-2 timeout and any later failure, cap or missing outcome
an infrastructure restore only when independently evidenced as a permitted interruption and still within the frozen maximum-one restore limit
fourth_controller_clarification.ambiguous_phrase: The external admission and prior review use the shorthand no failedscience. Read literally as no failed row, it is broader than version 5 and conflicts with the protocol distinction between a retained failed row and a terminal/retried scientific run.
fourth_controller_clarification.bounded_meaning: For the optional fourth controller, no failedscience means: no terminal scientific-run restart, no retry of a capped/failed row, no new payload/run/session, and no seed/method/cap substitution. It does not mean that every row observed so far must be verified.
forbidden: a second attempt at seq 2 or any other row that reached its scientific cap
replacement of a failed row with a new seed, method, coefficient cap, trial cap or session identity
restart of a terminal scientific computation under the label of controller continuation
a new scientific payload, submission or gate identity
conversion, omission or relabeling of the timeout as verified or merely missing
later-cohort admission under version 5 after the observed scientific timeout
any deadline, budget, source, image, project, IAM or RBAC change
preconditions_that_remain_required: the exact durable request remains nonterminal and is admitted before G
the original scientific process/payload remains the same one; no replacement process or scientific submission is launched
request, source, images, worker and Pod identity match, except a separately permitted and evidenced infrastructure restore within maximum one
seq 2 remains a timeout and is not scheduled again
the remaining scheduler work consists only of other sequence numbers already present in the frozen 18-row plan
all existing controller-count, queue, build-timeout, active-worker-second, G and D guards pass
automatic retry is disabled for controller invocation 4 and no fifth invocation is admitted

observed_state.interpretive_assumption_from_task_owner: The same original fixed-N scientific computation remains RUNNING; request, payload, seed schedule, source, worker attempt and restore count are unchanged. This record does not independently query cloud state.

scope: Read-only interpretation of already-frozen version-5 controller-continuation terms after an observed failed warmup row. This record changes no protocol, admission, scientific payload, cloud resource, deadline, budget, retry limit, or result.
verdict: Bounded readiness for continued supervision only: the observed warmup timeout does not itself bar an optional fourth controller from supervising the same nonterminal fixed-N payload, but it must never be retried and it blocks later-cohort admission under version 5.
